items.name: Idaho Championship 2020
items.information: # The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Please make sure you are familiar with all of the WCA regulations. If you have never attended a competition before, or would like a refresher, please attend the competitor tutorial at 8:00 AM on Saturday. We would also reccomend you watch this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww). Competitors from Idaho are eligible for an Idaho Champion titile. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbkVLIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e621ea22d4b54e51b22df0f4ccf0b67779c76072/mini%20idaho%20champs%20black.png)
